details:
This update for python-pypdf fixes the following issues:

Changes in python-pypdf:

- CVE-2026-119209: negative /Index values and multiplied xref
  streams can lead to clamp bypass and server memory exhaustion
  (bsc#1288950)
- CVE-2026-119208: trusting forged /Count values in encrypted PDF
  page trees can lead to excessive resource consumption and denial
  of service (bsc#1288951)
- CVE-2026-119207: nested exception text accumulation in strict
  mode parsing can lead to memory amplification and application
  denial of service (bsc#1288952)
- CVE-2026-119206: repeated sequential /Nums scanning in
  page_labels resolution can lead to algorithmic complexity attacks
  and denial of service (bsc#1288944)
- CVE-2026-119205: misdirected reference tracking during dictionary
  cloning can lead to cycle-detection bypass and thread-hanging
  infinite loops (bsc#1288943)
- CVE-2026-119204: unbounded resource entry copying during
  page-tree flattening can lead to excessive memory allocation and
  denial of service (bsc#1288942)
- CVE-2026-119203: unterminated trailer search in incomplete
  cross-reference tables can lead to an infinite loop and
  thread-blocking denial of service (bsc#1288941)
